summary: The video highlights the Starlit Delights rebate event, which allows players to obtain up to 30,000 Dragon Crystals rebate (equivalent to 300 Heliolite Dice, doubling total dice gain up to 600). The creator discusses saving resources for major hero releases such as Child of Chaos and important endgame heroes like Tariz. He encourages players to evaluate their roster needs before deciding which banner to pull on.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Creator considers saving all resources for this hero.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.verdict: Important hero for S8 endgame bosses
heroes.note: Key hero for turn manipulation against chiefs and endgame boss content.

tips: Take advantage of the Starlit Delights rebate event to earn up to 30,000 extra Dragon Crystals.
Carefully plan whether to pull for endgame boss specialists like Tariz or save for Child of Chaos.
title: 🤩 DON’T MISS THIS! 🔥 S8 NEW REBATE + 30K Dragon Crystals = 600 Dice | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
